description: One static 16x16 pixel-art UI Ready status icon conveying successful completion: visibly use a check mark with asymmetrical arms. Transparent background. Readable silhouette at native 1x and 3x nearest-neighbor scale on dark navy #172336. Use the existing UI cool blue accent direction; #70b9ed is a color cue, not an exact required palette. Deliberate clean pixel clusters and edges. No fixed palette or binary-alpha restriction. Proposed representative sample before expanding the Working, Retry and Paused family; no approved style reference exists yet. Transparent background permits an intentional foreground plate or badge and authored partial-alpha subject edges if the check remains readable. Cool blue is an accent role, not a dominant-fill mandate. Asymmetrical arms have no mandatory length recipe. These are future contract clarifications, not a request for another generation.
